name: Outbound Sender Domain SSL Expiry Watchdog (dhRobin Systems)

parameters.content:
## n8n-outbound-sender-domain-ssl-expiry-watchdog
**dhRobin Systems** · Daily: sender domains → DNS + SSRF guard → TLS handshake (expiry, chain trust, hostname, protocol, key) → HTTPS security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, nosniff) → HTTP→HTTPS redirect → findings → Slack / webhook / HubSpot task / Notion page → audit.

**Safe by default.** With no environment variables set:
- `SANDBOX_MODE=true`: synthetic observations. **No DNS, TLS or HTTP traffic. No notifications.**
- `DRY_RUN=true`: alerts are composed, nothing is sent or written.

Needs `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=dns,tls,https,http,net` for live inspection.

### Inspection scope
- Connects to the **vetted resolved IP** with SNI/Host = domain. Private, loopback and link-local targets are refused unless `ALLOW_PRIVATE_TARGETS=true`.
- Port 465 (implicit TLS) supported. STARTTLS on port 25/587 is **not** inspected.
- Trust is evaluated against the Node.js CA store of the n8n host.

nodes.name: Daily Watchdog Schedule
nodes.notes: Daily at 06:00 in the workflow timezone (UTC).

nodes.name: Config & Safety Gate
nodes.notes: Typed, non-secret configuration under config.*. Channel flags only record whether a secret is set, never its value.

nodes.name: Load & Normalize Domain List
nodes.notes: Fixture, SENDER_DOMAINS or fetched list → validated, de-duplicated entries.

nodes.name: Evaluate Findings
nodes.notes: Severity per finding; domain status = worst finding.

nodes.name: Compose Alerts
nodes.notes: Slack blocks, webhook JSON, HubSpot tasks, Notion pages.

nodes.name: Webhook: Post Alert
nodes.notes: Generic JSON webhook (PagerDuty bridge, Teams relay, SIEM, …).

nodes.name: HubSpot: Create Tasks
nodes.notes: One task per alerting domain. Grant the write scope HubSpot lists for the Tasks API.
